method: Original checks written from Peter Thiel's public statements and writing (a published essay, a recorded lecture, interviews and the book Zero to One). Each check rests on at least two excerpts in references/quotes.md, each at most 25 words and cited to its source; book excerpts are cited to the book without page references. Adapted from a private working skill; personal and internal references were removed and the method kept. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Peter Thiel, his co-author or his firms.
